events.address: Astor Place Plaza, 26 Astor Pl, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: The Nitro Bar's first NYC pop-up, created with Reese's for the limited-time Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Latte.
events.what_is_free: Up to 1,000 Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Lattes per day, with recipe cards and Reese's Pumpkins; the first 100 guests each day are also advertised to receive a limited-edition koozie.
events.caveats: Open to the public with no RSVP requirement published. Current local coverage says service begins at 11 AM and offerings are while supplies last. A secondary event listing publishes a nominal 5 PM end, while another describes the event as 11 AM until supplies last; do not promise inventory through 5 PM.
events.practical_notes: At Astor Place Plaza in front of Chase Bank. Today is the final day. Arrive early because the free latte allocation and other giveaways can run out before the nominal end time.

events.address: Columbia University, Broadway & W 116th St, New York, NY 10027
events.what_it_is: The Columbia stop of Goodnotes' East Coast campus café tour with free specialty coffee, a photo booth, live DJ and merchandise giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Free specialty coffee, photo booth, live DJ and Goodnotes merch while supplies last; current event coverage says coffee is for the first 100 guests and an additional limited-edition gift is available to early arrivals.
events.caveats: Goodnotes' official tour page lists Columbia on September 15 and provides an RSVP path. The official page also says to RSVP, while current event coverage advertises the activation from 1–4 PM. Free merch is explicitly while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Columbia University stop, 1–4 PM. RSVP is the actionable admission path; arrive early if the free coffee or limited-edition gift is the priority.

events.address: Ulta Beauty Herald Square, 51 W 34th St, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A public Hempz pop-up outside Ulta Beauty centered on Serene Waters with Magnesium body care and a relaxation-themed beverage truck.
events.what_is_free: Free magnesium iced tea or lavender cold-foam matcha, Serene Waters mini body lotion, scratch-off prizes, and a Calm Kit for the first 50 guests, while supplies last.
events.caveats: The general 12:30–6:30 PM pop-up is described as open to the public. A separate 4–6:30 PM influencer meet-and-greet requires its own Eventbrite RSVP and has limited capacity; that restricted sub-event is not being represented as the admission requirement for the general pop-up. Gifts with purchase inside Ulta are separate from the advertised free outside samples/drinks.
events.practical_notes: General pop-up runs 12:30–6:30 PM at Herald Square. The first-50 Calm Kit and other freebies are while supplies last.

events.event_name: beecee Launch Day at SAINT Coffee
events.address: SAINT Coffee, 201 7th Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: Launch-day community pop-up for new beauty brand beecee at SAINT Coffee, with a first look at the brand and a casual coffee gathering.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 drinks are paid for by beecee, and mini beecee product is advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current event sources describe the 12–5 PM gathering as open to the public. The first-100-drinks offer is capacity-limited and mini product is while supplies last; those giveaways are not guaranteed for later arrivals.
events.practical_notes: SAINT Coffee on Seventh Avenue, noon–5 PM. Arrive near opening if the complimentary drink is the priority because only the first 100 are covered.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown — The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Ave between W 14th & W 15th St, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand activation celebrating Vitamin Enriched Face Base+, with product discovery, refreshments, scratch-off prizes and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Vitamin Enriched Face Base+ samples, refreshments and croissants, scratch-off prizes and interactive moments while supplies last; the first 100 guests are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The organizer's Eventbrite listing provides the free registration path and confirms noon–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle. Samples, refreshments and prizes are while supplies last. Photo/video content will be captured for Bobbi Brown social/digital use according to the organizer listing.
events.practical_notes: Thursday, September 17 from noon–6 PM. Free registration is available through the organizer's Eventbrite page; earlier arrival is best for the first-100 deluxe sample.
